Grokking the Data Science Interview ([LINK_b01bd59d] )

Data science interviews reward the candidate who spots what’s wrong with an answer, like a join that double-counts revenue or a significant result that came from checking a test too often. Each lesson takes a real interview question, shows a common answer that falls short, then works through a stronger one along with the follow-ups an interviewer would ask. It runs from SQL and A/B testing through take-home assignments and product case questions, authored by our very own VP of Technical Content: Jordan Avery.

New on Fenzo

SAT Prep ([LINK_0840a696] )

Fenzo’s digital SAT program starts with a free diagnostic, which is like a shorter version of the real test. It then gives you a projected score on the 400 to 1600 scale and shows which content areas are costing points. From there, a study plan covers every skill on the test with short lessons and interactive practice. Once you've closed the gaps, you can progress to full-length mocks which mimic the digital SAT test environment.

Let us know what you think!

The Educative Team
